name: Disable Error Reporting And Advertising Data
description: Prevents Windows from sending error reports and advertising data.
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v DontShowUI /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent" /v DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent" /v DisableSoftLanding /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
revert22H2:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v DontShowUI /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent" /v DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent" /v DisableSoftLanding /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
